summary: Round 2 re-review: F1, F3, F4, F5 and F6 are closed, and F2 is closed as a finding because the plan now names a version rule and a major-step rule. One new Blocker sits in the amended version rule: the seroval floor >=1.6.1 leaves four high advisories, so Phase 1 cannot reach 0 high. Two new Major findings concern a scope contradiction and a Red/Green ownership sequencing gap.
blocking_findings: F7 [Blocker] plan.md Version rule: The seroval floor >=1.6.1 leaves four high advisories in place. Rationale: bun audit --json lists seroval highs at <=1.6.2 and <=1.6.7, so the smallest version that clears them is 1.6.8, and the npm registry confirms 1.8.2 exists; FR-2 and the acceptance criteria require 0 high, which contradicts the same line's promise of the smallest change that clears every critical and high.
nonblocking_findings: F8 [Major] spec.md Scope: The line 'No other folder changes' contradicts the amended record file and audit-check folder. Rationale: FR-2, FR-3 and the acceptance criteria now name measure/tracks/deps_refresh_20261122/advisories.md, and the plan creates tests/deps_audit/test.sh, run.sh, allow.txt and fixtures/; the scope line must name these exceptions.

F9 [Major] plan.md Ownership and Task 1.1: Red owns test.sh and fixtures while Green owns run.sh, but Task 1.1 asks Red to prove a live run exits 1. Rationale: run.sh does not exist at Red time, so the live case cannot return exit 1 then; the plan should name who creates run.sh before the live proof and when that proof is recorded.
evidence: HEAD verified: 3372b1bc37ae18aa6a7311cb2897561619018897, short 3372b1b, branch chore/deps-refresh, clean working tree; equals the audited_head_sha in this result.
F1 closed: plan.md names tests/deps_audit/run.sh, exit codes 0, 1 and 2, the optional allow.txt, the DEPS_AUDIT_FIXTURE_DIR fixture contract, and the bundle equality command in Task 1.3.

F2 closed as a finding: plan.md now states a version rule with named floors and a major-step rule with a code-fix and record fallback; FR-4 states the solid-js 2 host rule. The floors are checked again below.
F3 closed: Tasks 1.2 and 2.1 name the package.json, bun.lock, bundle and source files they change.
F4 closed: spec.md FR-2, FR-3 and the acceptance criteria, and plan.md Tasks 1.3 and 2.2, name measure/tracks/deps_refresh_20261122/advisories.md.

F5 closed: Task 1.1 names seven cases, including exit 1 for one critical, exit 1 for one high, exit 0 for moderate and low only, exit 0 for no advisories, exit 0 for an allowed high, exit 2 for bad JSON, and the live Red proof; Task 2.2 names the Phase 2 case.
F6 closed: due dates 2026-11-23 and 2026-11-25 appear on both phases and on every task.
bun audit --json from round 1 reproduced the before counts and gives the seroval ranges used in F7; the npm registry returns seroval 1.8.2, so a version above 1.6.8 exists.

The npm registry entry for vitest 3.2.6 declares vite ^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0 || ^7.0.0-0 and tinypool ^1.1.1; the plan's phrase 'matching vite and tinypool' has no named floor, but the same line's rule to take the smallest change that clears every critical and high determines those floors from the audit output.

Zoom-out check: the track fixes the root cause, adds no speculative feature and no premature optimization; the audit check is a new folder because no existing bun audit check exists in the repository.
Zero-decision check: schema is not applicable; CLI shape, edge cases and file locations are now named; the dependency floor defect is F7.

paraphrase.proposes: This chore track updates every package in extensions/measure-status and plugins/opencode-measure-guard to the latest working version. Phase 1 takes the smallest version steps that clear all critical and high advisories by 2026-11-23, using bun overrides where a parent has no fixed release. Phase 2 takes the latest working versions for the rest and writes the reasoned moderate and low list by 2026-11-25. A new audit check under tests/deps_audit/ fails on unapproved critical or high advisories, and the record file is advisories.md. All work stays on chore/deps-refresh and is pushed only to origin/chore/deps-refresh.
paraphrase.current_system: Per the spec, extensions/measure-status is an OpenChamber 2.7.1 and newer panel extension with five dev dependencies and a committed esbuild bundle at panel/main.js. plugins/opencode-measure-guard is a Bun-loaded OpenCode 2 plugin with pinned dev dependencies and peer floors of @opencode/plugin >=2.0.0, @opentui/* >=0.6.6 and solid-js >=1.9.0. The 2026-11-22 bun audit recorded 21 advisories in measure-status (4 critical, 5 high, 11 moderate, 1 low) and 8 in the guard (1 critical, 4 high, 3 moderate). Verification uses tsc, vitest, bun test, check-parity.sh and heavy-run.sh, with the bundle rebuilt by esbuild.
